title: Perioctahedral
summary: PERIOCTAHE'DRAL, adjective [Gr. octahedral.] Designating a crystal whose primitive form is a four sided prism, and in its secondary form is converted into a prism of eight sides.

inlines.v: PERIOCTAHE'DRAL, adjective [Gr. octahedral.] Designating a crystal whose primitive form is a four sided prism, and in its secondary form is converted into a prism of eight sides.
